title: SentinelHeartbeat
description: Schema for MEDIATE Message M12. This message is periodically published by a Sentinel to report its operational and health status. It is consumed by the Service Manager and Orchestrator through the Overwatch Broker.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be sentinelHeartbeat.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Sentinel heartbeat was generated.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the heartbeat message.

relatedSentinel.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity that generated the heartbeat.

operationalStatus.description: Property. Current operational status of the Sentinel.

healthStatus.description: Property. Current health status of the Sentinel.

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: Property. Expected interval, in seconds, between two heartbeat messages from the Sentinel.
